game.hangman.title._context: Title for a word guessing game where players guess country names letter by letter. The game name 'Hangman' is a classic word game concept. If translating, use a culturally appropriate equivalent word-guessing game name from your language/culture, or translate as 'Word Guessing' / 'Letter Guessing' / 'Guess the Word' if no direct equivalent exists. The key concept is: players see blank spaces representing letters, guess one letter at a time, and try to complete the country name before running out of guesses.

game.facts.title._context: Title for a geography quiz game where players identify countries based on interesting facts about them. Players read facts (like population, landmarks, culture, geography) and guess which country matches those facts. Translate as 'Guess by Facts' / 'Identify by Facts' / 'Country Facts Quiz' - emphasizing that players use factual clues to identify countries.

party.answered_count._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Live mode: how many players have answered.

party.reveal.correct._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown after a right answer. {{.Points}} is points earned.

party.reveal.wrong._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown after a wrong answer.

party.reveal.timeout._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown when the player did not answer in time.

party.reveal.color._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown after a colour round. {{.Points}} is points earned.

party.reveal.color_timeout._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown when the player did not pick a colour in time.

party.next._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Button to go to the next question in a challenge.

party.finished.title._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Heading of the final results.

party.finished.winner._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown above the final results. {{.Name}} is the winner.

party.finished.you_won._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown when you have the top score.

party.again._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Host button to play again with the same group.

party.waiting_again.value: Waiting for the host to play again…
party.waiting_again._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown to guests on the final screen.

party.leave._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Button to leave the room.

party.new_game._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Button to go back to the setup screen.

party.points._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Short unit for points.

party.challenge.from._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Heading of a challenge before starting. {{.Name}} is who created it.

party.challenge.rules.value: {{.Rounds}} questions. Answer fast for more points.
party.challenge.rules._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Rules under the challenge heading.

party.challenge.start._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Button to start playing a challenge.

party.challenge.share.value: Send this link to friends so they can try to beat you.
party.challenge.share._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Hint next to the challenge link on the results screen.

party.challenge.playing._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Shown next to a player who has not finished the challenge yet.

party.error.not_found.value: Room not found. Check the code.
party.error.not_found._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Error when the room code does not exist.

party.error.full._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Error when the room has no free seats.

party.error.generic.value: Something went wrong. Please try again.
party.error.generic._context: Multiplayer page (play with friends). Generic error on the multiplayer page.
